svg.aria-label: MCV-9 Aurora spacecraft general arrangement blueprint: side, top, front and rear elevations plus longitudinal section A-A with parts list, dimensions and details
svg.title: IAC-BP-1147 — MCV-9 AURORA General Arrangement
svg.desc: Professional aerospace engineering blueprint of a crewed multipurpose spacecraft. Orthographic side, top, front and rear views at a common scale, a longitudinal cutaway section A-A with balloon key, engine and docking-port detail views, dimensions, scale bars, notes, parts list and title block. Pure static SVG — no JavaScript, no external assets.
